news: Alice's Prairie is a real game now, with big buttons and Alice alive!
kindLine: The pups are glad you watched.
missLine: A hawk got close. The pups are okay.
reasonGround: That was a sky threat. Ground was wrong.
reasonSnake: That was a sky threat. Snake was wrong.
iphoneHint: For full screen on iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
newsOld: Meet Alice and Wonderland! Play Pop-Up Lookout.
news2: All six Lookout levels, seeds to earn, and your progress is saved.
whySnake: The snake got past. Snakes need the Snake alarm.
whyHawk: The hawk got past. Hawks need the Sky alarm.
whyCoyote: The coyote got past. Coyotes need the Ground alarm.
whyRabbit: That was a rabbit. Rabbits are friends!
whyCloud: That was a cloud. Clouds are not hawks.
whyWonder: That was Wonderland. He is a friend!
news3: The screen can turn and the round keeps going. One menu, big cards, seeds saved.
